How it works

From sign-up to certificate in four steps.

  1. Enroll

    Pick a course and pay the one-time KES 1,000 registration fee to unlock access to it.

  2. Attend classes online

    Join live sessions or study recorded lessons on your own schedule.

  3. Pass the assessment

    Complete assignments and a final test to show what you learned.

  4. Receive your certificate

    Get your certificate with a unique number employers can verify.

Common questions

About the institute

How do I register for a course?

Tap Register at the top of the page and create your account with your name, phone, email, ID or passport number and a password. Choose your course and pay, then enter your payment reference. Once we confirm your payment, the course opens in My courses.

Do I need to be online at a set time?

Mostly no. You can study the lessons on your own schedule, from your phone or computer. If a course includes a live session, we send the date and time after you register, and a recording is available if you miss it.

Can I take more than one course?

Yes. You can register for as many courses as you like. The one-time KES 1,000 registration fee applies to each course.

What if I forget my password?

Tap Log in, type your email, and choose Forgot your password. We send you a link to set a new password. Check your spam folder. If the email does not arrive, message us on WhatsApp.

Can I log in on two devices?

No. For security, only one device can be logged in to an account at a time. If you log in on a new device, the old one is logged out. Please do not share your account.

Is the registration fee charged twice?

No. You see one total for each course, with a breakdown of the one-time registration fee and the course fee. You pay it once for that course.

Fees and payment

How much do the courses cost?

Course fees range from KES 2,500 to KES 8,000, and each fee is shown on its course card. The Certificate in Basic Caregiving package is KES 7,500.

Is there a registration fee?

Yes. There is a one-time registration fee of KES 1,000 for each course. It gives you access to the course. The course fee is paid in addition, and you can pay both together or separately.

How do I pay?

Pay by M-Pesa Paybill 600100 (account number 0100016742947), by Stanbic Bank transfer (account 0100016742947, Thika branch), or by PayPal, which also accepts cards. On the pay screen you see one total with a breakdown. After paying, enter your payment reference (your M-Pesa code, bank reference or PayPal transaction ID). Your course opens after we confirm the payment. See our Terms of payment and service.

Will I get a receipt?

Yes. M-Pesa, your bank or PayPal confirms your payment at once. After we confirm it, you can download a Gruis receipt as a PDF from My courses, for your records.

Certificates

How do I receive my certificate?

Pay, complete the modules, submit your assignment (it is checked automatically) and pass the final assessment. Your Gruis Certificate of Completion is then issued automatically in your account, where you can print it or save it as a PDF. It carries your name, course, date, the last four digits of your ID or passport number, a unique certificate number and a QR code.

Is the certificate government-accredited?

No, not yet. It is a Gruis Certificate of Completion. We are in the process of seeking government accreditation and international accreditation, and we will announce it on this website when it is granted.

Can an employer check my certificate?

Yes. Every certificate has a unique number and a QR code that opens a verification page. An employer can email gruis.edu@gmail.com or call or WhatsApp +1 (213) 337-8634 with that number and we will confirm it.

Contact

How can I contact you?

WhatsApp or call +1 (213) 337-8634, or email gruis.edu@gmail.com. We are based in Lusail, Doha, Qatar.

Ready to start?

Register, pay by M-Pesa or bank transfer, then enter your payment reference in My courses. We confirm it and your course opens.

Gulf job-ready support (GCC, Europe, UK and Asia)

For job seekers, including GTI graduates, who want to work abroad. We connect you directly with employers, with no agent commissions in between.

  • Guided by an experienced HR team. Our human resources team has extensive experience in GCC employment and established links with employers in the region.
  • Direct employer contacts, no agent commissions. We share job postings together with the company's official contact details.
  • You apply yourself. You contact the employer directly and make your own application.
  • Help with your documents. We prepare your CV and guide you through your passport and certificate of good conduct applications.

Please note: Gruis Training Institute is not a recruitment agent. We do not place workers or take fees from employers. Our HR team uses its experience and employer links to connect you directly with companies, and you apply yourself. We cannot guarantee a job, because employers make their own hiring decisions. Never pay anyone for a job offer, and always confirm an employer's details before you share money or documents.

Working in Qatar: free guidance and where to get help

If you are an African worker in Qatar facing a difficult situation, start here. This information is free.

If you have a problem with your employer or your papers:

  • Contact your country's embassy in Doha first. They can advise you and help in an emergency.
  • Use the official channels of the Qatari authorities, such as the Ministry of Labour (MOL) and the Ministry of Interior (MOI), for employment and residence matters.
  • Keep copies of your passport, contract, residence permit and any messages or receipts.
  • Be careful with anyone who asks for money to fix your papers. Ask for an official receipt and the name of the office handling your case.
  • Once your papers are in order and you are free to work, message us and our HR team can share direct employer contacts.

Please note: we are not a law firm or a government office, and we cannot promise an outcome. Decisions on documents and status are made by the Qatari authorities.

Passport and Certificate of Good Conduct help

We help you prepare your documents and guide you through the eCitizen application. Help fee: KES 1,000 for each application. The government fees are paid by you directly on eCitizen, at the official rate.

Passport application

For first-time applications, replacement or renewal, lost or damaged passports and change of names. The documents you need depend on the type. On eCitizen you fill in Form 19 and pay the prescribed fee, then take your 2 payment invoices to a biometrics appointment.

Pay KES 1,000 and start

Certificate of Good Conduct (Police Clearance)

Applied for through the DCI service on eCitizen. Your fingerprints must be taken in person at a Huduma Centre, DCI headquarters or an authorised Kenyan mission abroad. Paying the fee does not guarantee a certificate is issued.

Pay KES 1,000 and start

We will never ask for your eCitizen password, PIN or one-time codes. You stay in control of your own eCitizen account. Requirements can change, so always confirm the final list on eCitizen.

How it works

Common questions

Using our services

Do I need an account to use your services?

Yes. Create an account or log in, pay the service fee, and enter your payment reference. After we confirm your payment, the service opens for you. You can find your services and receipts in My courses.

Where can I read your payment terms?

Open Terms of payment and service at the bottom of the page. They cover payment methods, fees, refunds, accreditation and your account.

What writing services do you offer?

Technical and commercial proposals, tenders and bids, and grant proposals for businesses and organisations. Pay the KES 1,000 enquiry fee (about USD 8 for clients abroad), tell us what you need, and we send you a quote. The final price depends on the service.

Jobs in the GCC

Which countries do you share job openings for?

We share job openings in the Gulf (Qatar, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Bahrain and Oman), the United Kingdom, Europe and Asia. Job categories include facility management, security, hospitality, housekeeping, caregiving and healthcare support, domestic work, drivers and logistics, construction and technical trades, retail and sales, and office administration. Availability varies by country and season.

Do you help find jobs abroad?

Yes. Our HR team has extensive experience in GCC employment and links with employers. We share job postings together with the employer's official contact details, for free, and you apply to them directly, with no agent in between.

Are you a recruitment agent?

No. We do not place workers or take fees from employers. We connect you directly with companies, and you make your own application.

Can you guarantee me a job?

No. Employers make their own hiring decisions. We help you prepare and connect you with employers, but we cannot promise a job. Never pay anyone for a job offer.

What does career support cost?

Direct job postings and employer contacts are free. A one-time, non-refundable job-ready support fee of KES 5,000 applies. CV preparation is KES 1,000.

Do you help with passport and police clearance?

Yes. We assist with your passport application on eCitizen and your Certificate of Good Conduct. The government fees are paid at the official rate, separately from our fees.

Working in Qatar

I am an African in Qatar with an overstay or employer problem. Can you help?

We give free guidance and point you to the right official channels, such as your embassy in Doha, the Ministry of Labour (MOL) and the Ministry of Interior (MOI). We are not a law firm or a government office, and we cannot promise an outcome, because the Qatari authorities make the final decisions.

Do I have to pay you for this guidance?

No. The guidance on this page is free. Be careful with anyone who asks you for money to fix your papers.

Can you help me find a job in Qatar?

Once your papers are in order and you are free to work, our HR team can share direct employer contacts with you.

Company registration

Can you help me register a company in Qatar or the UAE?

Yes. We assist investors who want to start a company in Qatar or the UAE by guiding the registration process and helping prepare documents.

How much does company registration cost?

Fees depend on the type of company and where you register it, so message us on WhatsApp for a quote. Government and licensing fees are set by the authorities.

Are you a law firm?

No. We guide the process and help prepare your documents. Approvals are decided by the relevant authorities.

Terms of payment and service

These terms apply to our courses and to our other services (job-ready support, CV preparation, writing services and company registration). By paying or registering you accept them.

1. Who we are

Gruis Training Institute, Lusail, Doha, Qatar. WhatsApp +1 (213) 337-8634, email gruis.edu@gmail.com.

2. Accreditation and certificates

We are in the process of seeking government accreditation and international accreditation. Until it is granted, our certificates are Gruis Certificates of Completion and are not government-accredited qualifications. We will announce accreditation on this website when it is granted.

3. Fees

Each course has a course fee plus a one-time registration fee, shown together as one total with a breakdown before you pay. Fees are in Kenya shillings unless stated. Dollar and riyal amounts are estimates at our current rate. The fee shown when you register is the fee you pay.

4. Payment methods

  • M-Pesa Paybill 600100, account number 0100016742947, account name Gruis Training Institute.
  • Stanbic Bank transfer, account number 0100016742947, Thika branch.
  • PayPal, which also accepts cards. Card payments through Pesapal will be added when available.

Pay only through the details on this website. After paying, enter your payment reference. Your course or service opens after we confirm that the payment has reached us. Confirmation is done by our team and can take some time.

5. Receipts

After your payment is confirmed you can download a receipt from My courses. We keep a record of every payment.

6. Other services

  • Job-ready support: one-time service fee of KES 5,000, which is non-refundable. We are not a recruitment agent. We do not guarantee a job or a visa. Employers make their own decisions.
  • CV preparation: KES 1,000. Proposal, tender and writing services: KES 1,000 enquiry fee, then a quote.
  • Government fees, including eCitizen fees, are paid directly to the government at the official rate and are not part of our fees.

7. Refunds

Refund requests are considered individually. Please contact us as soon as possible if you paid in error or have a problem. Fees listed above as non-refundable cannot be refunded.

8. Your account

One account is for one learner. Do not share your login. For security, only one device can be logged in to an account at a time. We may suspend accounts that are shared or misused.

9. Certificates and verification

A certificate is issued after the course requirements are met. Each certificate has a unique number and QR code that anyone can use to verify it. We may withdraw a certificate obtained by cheating or false information.

10. Your information

We collect your name, contact details and ID or passport number to run your account and issue your certificate, and any documents you give us for a service. We do not sell your information. We send updates, newsletters and job adverts only if you agree, and you can unsubscribe at any time. Ask us to delete your information at any time.

11. Pictures on this website

Some pictures on this website are AI-generated illustrations. The people shown are not Gruis students or staff, and the pictures do not promise any result such as a job or a visa.

12. Changes

We may update these terms. The version on this website applies.
